description: deterministic nonuniform-share algebra; no hockey capture, fitted state or research input

reconstruction.deployment: one at deployment_columns[row]; zero elsewhere; offense rows 0:32 then defense 32:64
reconstruction.pair_common_error: control=true_maps; candidate=true_maps plus .3*R[:,0] in rows 0 and 1
reconstruction.inseparable_error: control=true_maps; candidate=true_maps plus R[:,0] in row 26 and minus R[:,0] in row 31
reconstruction.reference_shift: baseline plus .1*R[:,0] to every offense row and minus .2*R[:,1] to every defense row
reconstruction.carried_only: synthetic ids -2,-1; all-seen coefficient rows 0:2 set to 1000 and rows 34:36 set to -1000; exclude before deployment

verification.tolerance: abs(actual-expected)<=1e-8*(1+abs(expected)); signed contrasts use their own expected value
verification.independent_arithmetic: explicit weighted deployment rows checked against gram contractions, including every signed joint component
checked_invariants: truth insertion has zero fitted-map error
pair-common error cancels from pair score but affects deployment
signed player cross terms are retained
outside-basis truth has cancelling omitted excess
inseparable differences have zero deployment contribution
same-role reference shifts preserve every risk
large carried-only rows are excluded by identity
